characters: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG sprite atlas for an actual 2D zombie survival beat-em-up game. Make a precisely aligned 3 column by 2 row atlas, 1536 x 1024 pixels. Each cell is exactly 512 x 512. Each full-body character occupies the central 270 pixels of its cell, with feet aligned 450 pixels below the top of each cell; all parts fit within the cell leaving transparent padding. Genuinely TRANSPARENT background, no white background, no shadows, no ground, no labels, no separators. Camera is classic arcade 3/4 side view; every character faces RIGHT. Premium detailed 32-bit pixel art, visible crisp 2-3 pixel clusters, dark pixel outlines, realistic human proportions NOT chibi NOT minecraft NOT toy blocks, strong anatomy and clothing folds. Row 1 column 1: male survivor, short dark hair, tan weathered jacket, dark cargo trousers, brown boots, green backpack, holding pistol aimed right, ready stance. Row 1 column 2: same exact survivor taking a walking stride with pistol aimed right. Row 1 column 3: ordinary thin male zombie in torn olive jacket, gray-green skin, staggering arms towards right. Row 2 column 1: female runner zombie, long messy blonde hair, gray torn sleeveless top, teal gray skin, dynamic running stance towards right. Row 2 column 2: large heavyset zombie in torn dark green coat, pale face, heavy boots, lumbering towards right. Row 2 column 3: enormous infected foreman boss, worn mustard work jacket, heavy gloves, torn trousers, distinctive broad shoulders, holding a broken metal pipe. No explicit gore. All figures equally detailed with clear readable silhouettes. Only six full-body sprites, precisely positioned one in each cell.
finalChromaKey: Use case: precise-object-edit. Keep the six pixel art figures exactly as in this image, at the same positions and sizes. Replace the entire checkerboard and EVERY background pixel between the figures with ONE perfectly uniform flat pure vivid magenta RGB(255,0,255), hex #FF00FF. This image is a game sprite atlas for chroma-key rendering, so absolutely NO shadows, no gradient, no glow, no checkerboard, no textures in the background. Background must be a uniform solid pure magenta in ALL six cells. Keep crisp figure boundaries, preserve all characters and their colors. Keep 1536x1024 dimensions.
